name: Get Google search volume and CPC for a keyword list to Google Sheets with Apify

parameters.content:
# Get Google search volume and CPC for a keyword list to Google Sheets with Apify

Paste a keyword list and get Google Ads Keyword Planner numbers back as a spreadsheet: average monthly searches, competition, the top-of-page bid range, the 12-month trend direction and CPC wherever Google publishes one, one row per keyword.

### Who it's for
SEO and PPC people who need real Keyword Planner figures for a list without a Google Ads account, and without modelled or invented numbers.

### How it works
1. A Set node holds the keyword list (one per line or comma-separated), the country, the language and the mode.
2. An HTTP Request runs the Keyword Search Volume Scraper on Apify, which returns the licensed Keyword Planner metrics. Keywords Google has no data for come back uncharged.
3. An If node drops the run's summary row, a Set node tidies the columns and a Google Sheets node appends one row per keyword.

### Setup
1. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential (name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`) and select it on the HTTP Request node.
2. Connect Google Sheets and pick the spreadsheet and sheet.
3. Open the Config node, paste your keywords, set the country (`US`, `GB`, `DE`) and language (`en`, `de`).
4. Run the workflow.

### Requirements
An Apify account and a Google account. A 50-keyword test is about $0.40 on the free plan; from 16 September 2026 a run that buys fresh data also pays one $0.19 fresh-lookup fee, so the same test is about $0.59, and a run answered from the actor's 30-day cache pays none. If you set a Maximum cost per run, make it at least $0.25 from that date.

### Customization tips
Set `mode` to `ideas` to expand every keyword into new keyword ideas with the same metrics, or `both`. Feed the list from a Google Sheet instead of the Config node. Add a Schedule Trigger to refresh a keyword set monthly.

## 1. Configure
Keywords, country, language and mode live in one Set node.

## 2. Look up
One Apify call returns Keyword Planner metrics; the If node keeps keyword rows only.

## 3. Save
Tidy the columns and append one row per keyword to Google Sheets.
